title: Multi-Currency Accounting

function_ids.U103-FX01: account.move.line foreign currency fields (amount_currency, currency_id, company_currency_id, currency_rate, balance/debit/credit denomination)
function_ids.U103-FX02: account.move invoice-level currency rate fields (invoice_currency_rate, expected_currency_rate, _compute_invoice_currency_rate)
function_ids.U103-FX03: Exchange-difference entry linkage fields (exchange_diff_partial_ids on account.move; exchange_move_ids on account.move.line; exchange_move_id on account.partial.reconcile)
function_ids.U103-FX04: Exchange journal and account selection helpers (_get_exchange_journal, _get_exchange_account; company-level fields currency_exchange_journal_id, income_currency_exchange_account_id, expense_currency_exchange_account_id)
function_ids.U103-FX06: Exchange difference computation during reconciliation (_prepare_reconciliation_single_partial no_exchange_difference context guard)
function_ids.U103-FX07: Partial reconcile unlink cascade (exchange_move_id reversal/deletion on account.partial.reconcile.unlink)
function_ids.U103-FX09: account.payment multi-currency line construction (_prepare_move_lines_per_type liquidity balance via _convert; counterpart mirroring)
function_ids.U103-FX10: amount_residual / amount_residual_currency computation (SQL aggregation from account.partial.reconcile)
function_ids.U103-FX11: account.automatic.entry.wizard scope (no unrealized FX revaluation in community account module)

key_findings: amount_currency (account_move_line.py:142) is the foreign-currency amount field; balance/debit/credit are always in company currency.
currency_rate is non-stored on account.move.line; for invoices it reads invoice_currency_rate from the parent move, otherwise calls res.currency._get_conversion_rate at move date.

Exchange difference entries are created by _create_exchange_difference_moves (account_move_line.py:3088) during reconciliation, linked via account.partial.reconcile.exchange_move_id (account_partial_reconcile.py:24).
FX P&L routing: positive residual → company.expense_currency_exchange_account_id (loss); negative → income_currency_exchange_account_id (gain). Company-level journal: currency_exchange_journal_id.
The account module has NO unrealized FX revaluation wizard. account.automatic.entry.wizard only covers change_period and change_account. FX differences are realised at reconciliation time only.
Reversal of a partial reconciliation automatically reverses or deletes the exchange difference entry (account_partial_reconcile.py:119).
res.currency._get_conversion_rate (res_currency.py:273) resolves rates against the root company for multi-branch support.
account.payment uses currency_id._convert() at payment date to set liquidity balance; counterpart mirrors exactly; rate difference resolved via exchange difference at reconciliation.
notes: No unrealized FX revaluation module exists in community edition. DeepSeek claim of 'account_current_assets_move' or 'account.revaluation' wizard is NOT confirmed — no such file or class found in the addons tree.
